title: Worn incisal edges from grinding, night guard

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: My wife says I grind my teeth at night.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: I can see it. Numbers eight and nine have flattened incisal edges, that's attrition from grinding.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Your jaw muscles are tender too.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Taking impressions today for a night guard. We'll deliver it in about ten days.
